blocks.text: You message and call the same people who later stand in your hallway with a drill. We do not pass jobs on to anyone else.

We do small repairs in flats: we started as labourers on renovations and now work as our own crew. We do not pretend to do everything: we will not touch gas pipework or the building's incoming supply, because that is work for a licensed specialist. We will tell you in the chat instead of wasting your day.

We arrive with our own tools, including a vacuum — after drilling there is no grey film left on your books. Shoes come off or covers go on, furniture gets sheeted. That sounds like a detail until someone treads concrete dust into your living room.
We can talk in English, Polish, Ukrainian or Russian, whichever is easier for you. You get a receipt, and a VAT invoice for your company on request.

blocks.text: The four things people usually worry about

items: I don't know what I'll pay
The calculator prices your selected items. We confirm the price before starting. Additional work proceeds only after you approve its cost.
What if they don't show up
We confirm an arrival time before departure. If it changes or we are running late, we let you know in advance.
They'll leave a mess
Sheeting on the furniture, vacuum at the drill, packaging leaves with us. The flat stays liveable.
They'll take on something they don't know
Electrical scope is confirmed before the visit; we do not work on gas systems or the building supply connection.

blocks.text: Describe the problem, get a price
Write on WhatsApp or call: a photo and one sentence are enough for a price. Or price the whole job yourself — in the calculator on the home page.
